name: andesine
description: Search, read, write, and publish the content of an Andesine workspace: a knowledge base, headless CMS, and docs platform.

interface.longDescription:
Andesine is a knowledge base, headless CMS, and docs platform. Connect a workspace to search and read your entries, draft new ones that follow your collection schemas, edit existing content as MDX, save and restore versions, and publish to your sites.

When you connect, you pick the workspace and whether the app can only read or can also make changes. Every request uses your own Andesine permissions. Edits appear live for people working on the same entries, and a version is saved before the first edit of an entry, so changes can be undone.
capabilities: Search workspace content by meaning and keywords
Read entries as MDX with their fields and linked entries
Create draft entries that follow collection schemas
Edit parts of entries or rewrite them
Move, rename, and delete entries and collections
Save versions and restore earlier ones
Publish and unpublish content on channels
defaultPrompt: Find what our docs say about authentication
Draft a new guide in /Guides about getting started
Summarize what changed since the last publish

positive.description: Answer a question from workspace content
positive.prompt: What does our Getting started guide say about installing the CLI?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds /Guides/Getting started, reads it, and answers from its installation section with a link to the entry.

positive.prompt: List the collections and entries in my Andesine workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the /Guides and /API collections with their entries.

positive.description: Edit part of an existing entry
positive.prompt: Add a short Troubleshooting section to /Guides/Getting started that explains how to sign in again when a session expires.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the entry, adds a Troubleshooting section at the end without changing the rest, and replies with a link to the entry.

positive.description: Create a draft entry that follows the schema
positive.prompt: Create a draft FAQ entry in /Guides with three common questions about billing.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an unpublished entry /Guides/FAQ with the required fields filled, and replies with its link.
Asks for confirmation, publishes the entry on the published channel, and confirms the result.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris today?
Write a short poem about the ocean.
Book a flight from Berlin to Tokyo for next Monday.

publication.release_notes: First release: search, read, create, edit, version, and publish Andesine workspace content.
